lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ is in the derivative form: غابِرين
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
غ/ب/ر   gh–b–r dust, earth, to gather dust, to remain, to depart, previous time; devastation, famine, poverty.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 8 times in the Qur’an:
غبرةٌ ghabaratun 1 time and غابِرين ghābirın 7 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
غابِرين ghābirın [pl. of act. part. غابِر ghābir] those who remain, who stay behind

(29:33) إِنَّا‏ ‏مُنَجُّوكَ‏ ‏وَأَهْلَكَ‏ ‏إِلاَّ‏ ‏امْرَأَتَكَ‏ ‏كَانَتْ‏ ‏مِنَ الْغَابِرِينَ We shall save you and your household, except for your wife–she will be among those who stay behind.

entries.label: غبِرةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
غبِرةٌ ghabaratun [n.] dust covering, layer of dust *

(80:40) وَوُجُوهٌ‏ ‏يَوْمَئِذٍ‏ ‏عَلَيْهَا ‏غَبَرَةٌ‏ but some faces will have a layer of dust on them, will be very gloomy.
